justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/viewer/TextViewerStage.java, ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/viewer/AbstractTextViewerStage.java, and ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/viewer/JournalViewerStage.java. TextViewerStage is only 62 lines and defines a single public constructor with no additional methods; it just normalizes input, optionally adds line numbers, builds Label rows, and delegates display setup to the abstract base. The shared formatting/window-sizing logic already lives in AbstractTextViewerStage, so TextViewerStage does not show excessive size, multiple responsibilities, or low cohesion strong enough to indicate insufficient modularization.
